checks.name: 구간+4%이상
checks.sql: SELECT PD_ABRV_NM, PD_NM FROM kr_bond WHERE STD_PD_MCLS_NM='회사채' AND MAT_DT > '2026-08-28' AND MAT_DT <= '2029-08-28' AND TRY_CAST(SRFC_IRT AS DOUBLE) >= 4

checks.name: 구간+5%이상
checks.sql: SELECT PD_ABRV_NM, PD_NM FROM kr_bond WHERE STD_PD_MCLS_NM='회사채' AND MAT_DT > '2026-08-28' AND MAT_DT <= '2031-08-28' AND TRY_CAST(SRFC_IRT AS DOUBLE) >= 5

checks.name: 비중 상위 3
checks.sql: SELECT c.etf_name, e.pd_abrv_nm FROM etf_constituent c JOIN kr_etp e ON c.etf_isin=e.pd_itm_no WHERE c.COMPST_ISU_CD='005930' AND e.drv_listing_status='active' ORDER BY TRY_CAST(replace(c.COMPST_RTO,',','') AS DOUBLE) DESC LIMIT 3

checks.name: 비중 상위 8 중 2
checks.sql: SELECT c.etf_name, e.pd_abrv_nm FROM etf_constituent c JOIN kr_etp e ON c.etf_isin=e.pd_itm_no WHERE c.COMPST_ISU_CD='005930' AND e.drv_listing_status='active' ORDER BY TRY_CAST(replace(c.COMPST_RTO,',','') AS DOUBLE) DESC LIMIT 8

checks.name: NAV 1위
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_listing_status='active' ORDER BY TRY_CAST(du_last_nav AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

checks.name: 거래대금 1위
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_listing_status='active' AND drv_instrument_type='ETF' ORDER BY TRY_CAST(du_val_1d AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

checks.name: 원자재 ETN
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETN' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND (pd_nm LIKE '%원자재%' OR pd_nm LIKE '%구리%' OR pd_nm LIKE '%원유%' OR pd_nm LIKE '%금%선물%' OR pd_nm LIKE '%은%선물%' OR pd_nm LIKE '%니켈%' OR pd_nm LIKE '%천연가스%')

checks.name: 27-표기 만기형
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE pd_nm LIKE '%27-%' AND drv_listing_status='active'

checks.name: A급 6%초과
checks.sql: SELECT PD_ABRV_NM, PD_NM FROM kr_bond WHERE STD_PD_MCLS_NM='회사채' AND TRY_CAST(drv_crd_grd_rank AS INT) BETWEEN 5 AND 7 AND TRY_CAST(SRFC_IRT AS DOUBLE)>6

checks.name: 보수 최저 후보
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE (cu_base_index LIKE '%코스피%200%' OR cu_base_index ILIKE '%KOSPI%200%' OR ref_base_index ILIKE '%KOSPI%200%' OR pd_nm LIKE '%200%') AND TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE)>0 AND drv_listing_status='active' ORDER BY TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE) ASC LIMIT 5

checks.name: 3중 결합 상위
checks.sql: SELECT PD_ABRV_NM, PD_NM FROM kr_bond WHERE STD_PD_MCLS_NM='회사채' AND MAT_DT > '2026-08-28' AND MAT_DT <= '2029-08-28' AND TRY_CAST(drv_crd_grd_rank AS INT) <= 4 ORDER BY TRY_CAST(SRFC_IRT AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3

checks.name: 순자산 상위 3
checks.sql: SELECT c.etf_name, e.pd_abrv_nm FROM etf_constituent c JOIN kr_etp e ON c.etf_isin=e.pd_itm_no WHERE c.COMPST_ISU_CD='005930' AND e.drv_listing_status='active' GROUP BY c.etf_name, e.pd_abrv_nm, e.pd_net_tamt ORDER BY TRY_CAST(e.pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3
